What's In the Patch:
Visual
    Bot visuals have been drastically improved. You will now see better visual organization for each command that corresponds to player information output.

- Removed rank and stats commands. Replaced with profile command. 
- New profile section displays your Rank, Grifbux, stats for the currently selected game.
- Colored bar in profile correlates to the player's current rank.
- Updated post game information display. Now shows both teams with each player's current rank and LP.

Lobby & Match Functionality
    The lobby system & win input system have been enhanced. Generation of a lobby will be faster and more precise than before. Additionally the ability to determine the hosting type has been added. These newer features are a step in the right direction to ultimately allow players to run their own lobbies.

- Bot will now create a lobby once 8 players have signed up.
- Addition of a command to select host type. Dedicated host positioned in Central is on by default.
- Addition of a voting system for players to determine the winning team. Votes are completed through selecting the corresponding emote for Red or Blue teams.
- On court host selection randomly selects a player from the lobby. Selected host will have a higher weighting applied to team generation. This will help balance teams more efficiently.

Base Rank Progression
    Standard rank progression has changed to work in tandem with the new placement & balancing system. In order to match the new speeds at which players will progress, the current numbers had to be swapped up.

- LP gains for wins reduced to 25 per win. Down from 30 per win.
- LP gains for losses reduced to -15 per loss. Down from 21 per loss.
- LP gains for 3 win streak increased to 25. Up from 10.
- LP gains for 6 win streak increased to 50. Up from 16.
- LP gains for 3 loss streak increased to -25. Up from -12.
- LP gains for 6 loss streak increased to -50. Up from -18.

Placements & Player Balancing
    Placements have been changed to handle the new rank progression. Instead of 5 matches to determine your starting position, you will have 3 matches to build your starting player grade. As you continue to play, your player grade will become more accurate, narrowing down your progression until you’ve reached the system desired rank. 

- Removed amateur & pro monikers.
- Placement match total reduced to 3 games. Down from 5.
- Placement MMR gains per win remain the same. MMR gains per loss remain the same.
- Accelerated LP gain system implemented based on player grade. Each grade has an MMR ranking correlated to it. Example acceleration:

            S Grade Player will receive
            300 LP (3 ranks) per win in Bronze.
            200 LP (2 ranks) per win in Silver.
            100 LP (1 rank) per win in Gold.
            50 LP per win in Platinum.
            25 LP (base gains) per win in Diamond.

Grifbux
    Means of earning Grifbux have been introduced through Late League. For every win you receive & every time you neutral host a match, you will receive 20 Grifbux. The bot will now keep track of all Grifbux earned, with a means to identify your current total via the profile command. As of now, every Sunday will be the payout period.

- Addition of Grifbux. Players receive 20 per win & 20 per neutral hosting.
- Profile command displays current Grifbux total.
- Grifbux are paid out every sunday.
- Grifbux total is purged on payout.
- All Grifbux earnings are retroactive.

Hotfix
- Reduced lobby generation loop timer down to 3 seconds. Down from 30 seconds
- Added a que for remove commands when a match is in session. Removes will initiate once stats have been written.

Hotfix
- Halo 4 medals have been added for stat tracking. Medals from previous matches are not retroactively added. This may change in the future.

Introduction of Season Lengths
        Late League will now have better organization & transparency with how seasons work. Each game will have a set season length by the number of hosted days. This allows for players to have a clear understanding of how many days they can effectively play.

- All Halo’s start with 30 session season length. Sessions are defined by a hosted day. 
- Seasons may increase in session length as seen fit.

Mid-End of Season Tournaments
        In order to improve competitiveness in a season, we’re introducing mid and end of season tournaments. More information will be give on this at a later date.

Visual
- Profile page now displays if a player has not played in the current season.
- Waitlist now displays estimated wait time for each player. First few sessions may display incorrect times. Estimated time will increase in accuracy for following sessions.
- Lobby now shows the remaining season length.

Lobby & Match Functionality
- Europe has been removed as an option for neutral & oncourt host.

Player Bot Command
In order to help facilitate automation, new commands have been added to the bot functionality. Likewise discord username handling has been improved.

- Bot will now handle discord user names with @USERNAME. 
- &kick @discordusername in order to start a vote kick. 5 votes are required to kick a player from the lobby.
- &drop will now allow players to drop themselves to the bottom of the wait-list.
- &board command added. &leaderboard removed.
- &board will now display the top 5 players for each Halo.
- &board halo4 | halo5 | haloreach | halo3 will display the top 15 players for the chosen game.

New Game Addition
        It’s about time to have a new game thrown in the mix. Halo 5 has been added in to help give those with the itch a chance to play competitively with others in the community.

- Halo 5 has been fully implemented into the bot & google sheet.
- Stat collection is fully automated from the Halo API
- Lobby generation times are longer than standard due to API response times.
